classification.difficultyReason: Range from dot plots needs the largest and smallest occupied scores, ignoring empty columns at the ends, then one subtraction.

content.prompt: Determine the range from these dot plots.

answer.worked:
The lowest observed score is 2; there are no dots at 1.
$$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{Range}&=8-2\\\mathrm{Range}&=6\end{aligned}$$

There are no dots at 40 or 70. The lowest observed score is 45 and the highest is 65.
$$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{Range}&=65-45\\\mathrm{Range}&=20\end{aligned}$$
